summary.zh: PyTorch 检查点转 ONNX（torch.onnx.export + onnxsim 简化），后续量化/推理的前置步骤。
summary.en: Convert a PyTorch checkpoint to ONNX (torch.onnx.export + onnxsim), the prerequisite for quantization and ONNX runtimes.

note.zh: 不需要数据；只需输入形状/opset。
note.en: No data needed; only input shape / opset.

note.zh: state_dict / torch.save(model) / build_model(config) 三种格式都支持
note.en: state_dict, torch.save(model) and build_model(config) are all supported

note.zh: 检查点只有权重时必须提供；同目录有 arch.py 时自动使用
note.en: Required when the checkpoint only holds weights; an arch.py next to the model is picked up automatically

compression.zh: 体积≈持平（FP32 精度不变，实测 +3%）

latency.zh: ONNX Runtime 通常略快于 PyTorch eager
latency.en: ONNX Runtime is usually slightly faster than PyTorch eager

limits.zh: 必须给输入形状；表格/非图像模型要显式指定（如 1x7）。
limits.en: Input shape is mandatory; non-image models must pass it explicitly (e.g. 1x7).

limits.zh: 默认静态 batch（1）；需要动态 batch 要加 --dynamic-axes，且动态 batch 与 INT8 动态量化组合受限。
limits.en: Static batch=1 by default; use --dynamic-axes for dynamic batch, which then conflicts with dynamic INT8 quantization.

limits.zh: YOLO 走 ultralytics 分支，需要 ultralytics 依赖与 imgsz。
limits.en: YOLO uses the ultralytics branch (needs the dependency and --imgsz).

summary.zh: 把 HuggingFace 因果语言模型转成 llama.cpp 的 GGUF（f16/q8_0/q4_K_M…），供 ollama/llama.cpp 生态直接加载。
summary.en: Convert a HuggingFace causal LM to llama.cpp GGUF (f16/q8_0/q4_K_M…) for ollama / llama.cpp.

format.zh: HF 模型目录（config.json 所在目录）
离线目录或可访问网络

note.zh: 用 --llama-cpp-path 指到含 convert_hf_to_gguf.py 的目录；否则引擎会联网拉取
note.en: Point --llama-cpp-path at a directory containing convert_hf_to_gguf.py; otherwise the engine fetches it online

compression.zh: 按 outtype：f16≈2×缩小，q4_K_M 约 4~5×缩小
compression.en: Depends on outtype: f16 ≈ 2×, q4_K_M ≈ 4–5× smaller

accuracy.zh: q4_K_M 通常 <1% 困惑度上升；f16 无损失
accuracy.en: q4_K_M usually <1% PPL increase; f16 lossless

latency.zh: llama.cpp CPU 推理，量化越低位越快
latency.en: llama.cpp CPU inference; lower bits run faster

limits.zh: 需要 llama.cpp 的 convert_hf_to_gguf.py；离线环境要把工具放进 deploy/compress/llama-cpp/（或 --llama-cpp-path 指向本机 checkout）。
limits.en: Requires llama.cpp's convert_hf_to_gguf.py; offline hosts must place it in deploy/compress/llama-cpp/ (or point --llama-cpp-path at a local checkout).

limits.zh: 自定义架构（非 llama/qwen/gpt 系）可能不被工具支持。
limits.en: Custom architectures outside the llama/qwen/gpt families may be unsupported.

limits.zh: 实测：Qwen2.5-0.5B → q4_K_M 511 MB（−48.8%）、31 s、离线可复现；困惑度损失未单独测（PPL 见 INT4 行）。
limits.en: Measured: Qwen2.5-0.5B → q4_K_M 511 MB (−48.8%) in 31 s, fully offline; perplexity loss not measured separately (see the INT4 row for PPL).

evidence.dataset: Qwen2.5-0.5B（服务器本地 HF 目录）

summary.zh: q4_K_M 511 MB（HF 基线 1000 MB，−48.8%）；使用本机离线 llama.cpp 工具完成（无需联网）；outtype=q4_K_M；耗时 31 s
summary.en: q4_K_M 511 MB (HF baseline 1000 MB, −48.8%); converted with the on-host llama.cpp toolchain (no network); outtype=q4_K_M; took 31 s

summary.zh: onnxruntime 权重动态量化（激活运行时定标）：免校准数据、一条命令把 FP32 ONNX 压到约 1/4。
summary.en: onnxruntime weight-only dynamic quantization: no calibration data, roughly 4× smaller than the FP32 ONNX.

note.zh: 仅当 ONNX 带 external data 时必填；引擎会把权重内联成单文件
note.en: Only required for ONNX with external data; the engine inlines it into a single file

limits.zh: 只量化权重，激活仍 FP32：提速有限（本 demo 反而比静态 INT8 慢 5×）。
limits.en: Weights only, activations stay FP32: limited speed-up (here 5× slower than static INT8).

limits.zh: 动态 batch 注意力图与动态量化组合会触发 onnxruntime 形状限制。
limits.en: Dynamic-batch attention graphs conflict with ORT quantizer shape checks.

limits.zh: 旧导出器写的形状标注自相矛盾时，引擎自动剔除 value_info 重试（看 metrics.shape_repair）。
limits.en: When legacy exporters write contradictory shape annotations the engine strips value_info and retries (see metrics.shape_repair).

summary.zh: QDQ 静态量化（权重+激活都定点）：用一批代表性图片校准激活范围，CPU 上通常最快。
summary.en: QDQ static quantization (weights and activations): calibrate activation ranges on real images — usually the fastest CPU option.

note.zh: 需要按类图片目录（本次用 CIFAR10-train 的 512 张）。
note.en: Needs a per-class image directory (512 images from CIFAR10-train here).

format.zh: 校准样本数（默认 16；实测 512 更稳）

latency.en: p50 0.079 ms / p99 0.247 ms, 2,553 samples/s — fastest of the batch

limits.zh: 必须有代表性校准集，分布不匹配会明显掉精度。
limits.en: A representative calibration set is mandatory; mismatched data costs accuracy.

limits.zh: 校准数据要用按类目录结构（class_x/*.jpg|png|bmp）。
limits.en: Calibration data must use per-class folders (class_x/*.jpg|png|bmp).

limits.zh: 只量化常见算子，自定义算子保持 FP32。
limits.en: Only common ops are quantized; custom ops stay FP32.

summary.zh: 导出 OpenVINO IR 并用 NNCF 做训练后 INT8 量化（也可 FP16），产物是 model.xml + model.bin 目录。
summary.en: Export OpenVINO IR and quantize with NNCF (or FP16); the artifact is a model.xml + model.bin directory.

note.zh: INT8 需要校准图片；FP16/FP32 不需要（--precision）。
note.en: INT8 needs calibration images; FP16/FP32 do not (--precision).

format.zh: ONNX 或 PyTorch 检查点
按类图片目录（INT8 校准）

limits.zh: 产物是目录（model.xml/model.bin），部署/下载要整目录带走。
limits.en: Artifact is a directory (model.xml/model.bin) — ship the whole folder.

limits.zh: 静态 batch 输入：批量推理需按固定批量喂入。
limits.en: Static-batch input: batch inference must feed the fixed batch size.

limits.zh: Intel CPU 上收益最大；其它平台退化为通用后端。
limits.en: Biggest gains on Intel CPUs; other vendors fall back to a generic backend.

summary.zh: HuggingFace 大模型 → OpenVINO IR 的权重压缩（optimum-intel / NNCF INT4）：免校准，把 0.5B 级模型压到约 1/4。
summary.en: HuggingFace LLM → OpenVINO IR weight compression (optimum-intel / NNCF INT4): no calibration, takes a 0.5B model to about 1/4.

note.zh: 权重压缩不需要校准数据。
note.en: Weight compression needs no calibration data.

format.zh: HF 模型目录 / 模型 ID

compression.zh: INT4 约 3.5~4×（0.999 GB → 见报告实测值）
compression.en: INT4 ≈3.5–4× (0.999 GB → measured value in the report)

latency.zh: CPU 生成明显提速（tokens/s 见报告）
latency.en: Clearly faster CPU generation (tokens/s in the report)

limits.zh: 产物是 OpenVINO IR 目录，需用 OV/GenAI 或平台推理接口加载。
limits.en: Artifact is an OpenVINO IR directory; load with OV/GenAI or the platform inference API.

limits.zh: 超小模型（<0.5B）INT4 掉点更明显，建议 group 128 + sym。
limits.en: INT4 hurts tiny models (<0.5B) more; prefer group 128 + sym.

limits.zh: NNCF INT4 走 CPU 通道压缩，长上下文吞吐受内存带宽限制。
limits.en: NNCF INT4 uses CPU channel compression; long-context throughput is memory-bandwidth bound.

summary.en: 66.1% smaller; IR 339 MB (baseline 1000 MB); engine light-eval PPL 5.295; platform bench p50 1307 → 704 ms (2.156× speed-up); peak memory 2381 → 1243 MB; took 8713 s

summary.zh: 按滤波器重要性（L1/L2/BN-Slim）或数据驱动准则（AutoSlim/GroupFisher/DMCP）整通道裁剪 CNN，再导出瘦身后的图。
summary.en: Remove whole CNN filters by importance (L1/L2/BN-Slim) or data-driven criteria (AutoSlim/GroupFisher/DMCP) and export the slimmed graph.

note.zh: L1/L2/BN-Slim 免数据；AutoSlim/GroupFisher/DMCP 需要按类图片目录。
note.en: L1/L2/BN-Slim need no data; AutoSlim/GroupFisher/DMCP need a per-class image directory.

note.zh: 剪枝要重建网络并改通道数
note.en: Pruning rebuilds the network with new channel counts

format.zh: 按类图片目录（仅数据驱动准则）

latency.zh: p50 0.126 ms（CPU 小网络收益有限）
latency.en: p50 0.126 ms (small nets gain little on CPU)

limits.zh: 只支持含 Conv2d 的 CNN；纯 Transformer/MLP 报 No Conv2d layers found。
limits.en: CNN (Conv2d) only; pure Transformer/MLP fails with “No Conv2d layers found”.

limits.zh: 必须提供 arch.py（能重建模型）。
limits.en: arch.py is mandatory (model must be rebuildable).

limits.zh: 剪完要自己接 QAT/微调，否则精度不可用。
limits.en: Follow with QAT/fine-tuning, otherwise accuracy is unusable.

limits.zh: 分类头维度会自动对齐，这会改变 head 权重映射，是掉点主因之一。
limits.en: The classifier head is auto-adjusted, rewiring head weights — one of the main accuracy hits.

summary.zh: 按幅值把最小的权重置零（非结构化稀疏）：结构不变，适合存储压缩与后续稀疏推理。
summary.en: Zero the smallest weights by magnitude (unstructured sparsity): the graph is unchanged; useful for storage and sparsity-aware runtimes.

compression.zh: 稠密存储不变小（要稀疏格式才体现）
compression.en: Dense storage does not shrink (needs a sparse format)

accuracy.zh: 小幅扰动，rate 0.3 一般 <1pp（见报告实测）
accuracy.en: Small perturbation, usually <1pp at rate 0.3 (see report)

latency.zh: 稠密 CPU 推理不变快
latency.en: No speed-up for dense CPU inference

limits.zh: 非结构化、不改通道数，产出仍是稠密张量。
limits.en: Unstructured: channel counts and dense tensors unchanged.

limits.zh: 要加速需配合稀疏内核或再做一次结构化剪枝。
limits.en: Speed-up needs sparse kernels or a follow-up structured prune.

limits.zh: 本实验只验证流程与精度扰动。
limits.en: This experiment validates the pipeline and accuracy perturbation only.

summary.zh: 教师模型输出指导学生模型训练（logits KD / FitNets features），把大模型能力迁移到更小的网络。
summary.en: Train a smaller student from the teacher's outputs (logits KD / FitNets features).

note.zh: 需要按类图片目录（本次 CIFAR10-train 50,000 张）。
note.en: Needs a per-class image directory (50,000 images from CIFAR10-train here).

format.zh: 轮数 / 温度 / KD 权重

compression.zh: 取决于学生宽度（width_mult<1 才压缩；本次 width_mult 未生效，体积≈基线）
compression.en: Depends on student width (only width_mult<1 compresses; here it had no effect, size ≈ baseline)

accuracy.zh: 3 epoch：随机学生 8.7% → 49.4%；10 epoch 见报告
accuracy.en: 3 epochs: random student 8.7% → 49.4%; 10-epoch run in the report

latency.zh: 学生与教师同构时与基线同量级
latency.en: Same order as baseline when student matches teacher architecture

limits.zh: 需要教师+学生可重建（arch.py）。
limits.en: Teacher and student must be rebuildable (arch.py).

limits.zh: 训练成本高：3 epoch 已 258 s（CPU）。
limits.en: Training cost is high: 3 epochs took 258 s on CPU.

limits.zh: width_mult 对 VGG-ish 顺序网络无效（实测学生参数量=教师），真要压缩请用剪枝/量化。
limits.en: width_mult has no effect on this VGG-ish sequential net (student params == teacher); use pruning/quantization for real compression.

summary.zh: 在训练中模拟量化误差（FX QAT / LSQ），导出量化 ONNX：比纯训练后量化更保精度，代价是要训练。
summary.en: Simulate quantization during training (FX QAT / LSQ) and export a quantized ONNX: better accuracy than post-training quantization at the cost of training.

note.zh: 需要按类图片目录（训练/校准共用）。
note.en: Needs a per-class image directory (used for both training and calibration).

accuracy.zh: 实测**轮次是关键**：1 epoch/4k 仅 62.8%，10 epoch/4k 升到 66.8%（+4.0pp，val loss 0.9225→0.8093）；但仍低于静态 PTQ 的 68.68%——要超过 PTQ 需要全量数据（本机 50k 会被 OOM 杀）
accuracy.en: Measured: **epochs matter** — 1 epoch/4k gives 62.8%, 10 epochs/4k reach 66.8% (+4.0pp, val loss 0.9225→0.8093), still below static PTQ (68.68%); beating PTQ needs the full dataset (50k is OOM-killed on this host)

latency.zh: 与静态 INT8 同级（10 epoch 实测 p50 0.119 ms / p99 0.433 ms）
latency.en: Same as static INT8 (10-epoch run: p50 0.119 ms / p99 0.433 ms)

limits.zh: CLI 已支持：`--method=qat --algo=fx_int8|lsq`（需要 --dataset-path 按类图片目录）。
limits.en: CLI support: `--method=qat --algo=fx_int8|lsq` (requires --dataset-path with per-class images).

limits.zh: 必须在有 passwd 条目的用户下运行：容器内 uid 无 passwd 时 FX QAT 会退回 fine-tune+PTQ（实测报 getpwuid uid not found）。
limits.en: Must run as a user that exists in the image: without a passwd entry FX QAT silently falls back to fine-tune + PTQ (observed “getpwuid uid not found”).

limits.zh: 只在 Conv/Linear 等 FX 可追踪模块上生效；动态控制流图会失败。
limits.en: Only works on FX-traceable Conv/Linear modules; dynamic control flow fails.

limits.zh: 内存占用高：全量 50k 图像跑 1 epoch 与 10 epoch 均被 OOM 杀掉（实测 exit 137 ×2），必须用子集。
limits.en: Memory hungry: the full 50k-image run was OOM-killed at both 1 and 10 epochs (exit 137 twice) — use a subset.

limits.zh: 轮次不够时精度会明显低于静态 PTQ（1 epoch 实测 62.8% vs 68.68%），别只看体积。
limits.en: With too few epochs QAT is clearly worse than static PTQ (62.8% vs 68.68% at 1 epoch) — size is not the only metric.

summary.zh: 冻结底模只训练低秩适配器（LoRA），可再合并回底模；HuggingFace 模型需要 CUDA，PyTorch 检查点走 CPU 微型原型。
summary.en: Freeze the base model and train a low-rank adapter (LoRA), optionally merged back. HuggingFace models need CUDA; PyTorch checkpoints use the CPU micro prototype.

note.zh: 需要指令/偏好数据：alpaca(.jsonl) 用于 SFT，hh-rlhf 用于 DPO。
note.en: Needs instruction/preference data: alpaca (.jsonl) for SFT, hh-rlhf for DPO.

compression.zh: 不压缩底模；适配器本身仅几 MB（可单独分发）
compression.en: Does not compress the base model; the adapter itself is a few MB and can be shipped alone

accuracy.zh: 取决于数据量与轮数（微调目标是任务适配，不是压缩）
accuracy.en: Depends on data and epochs (goal is task adaptation, not compression)

latency.zh: 推理时若不合并适配器会略慢；合并后无额外开销
latency.en: Slightly slower if the adapter is not merged; no overhead once merged

limits.zh: HF 路径必须 CUDA：CPU 只有内置微型字符 LM 原型（流程验证用）。
limits.en: The HF path requires CUDA; CPU only has the built-in micro char-LM prototype (pipeline validation).

limits.zh: 指令数据要能被解析（csv/xlsx/jsonl；jsonl 常见字段 instruction/input/output）。
limits.en: Instruction data must be parseable (csv/xlsx/jsonl; typical jsonl fields instruction/input/output).

limits.zh: 本环境 8GB 显存：0.5B + rank 8 + max_len 128 可跑，更大模型需降 batch/长度。
limits.en: 8 GB VRAM here: 0.5B + rank 8 + max_len 128 fits; larger models need smaller batch/length.

summary.zh: 可部署适配器 4.4 MB；另含合并模型 1976 MB（可只分发适配器）；可训练参数 1081344；末轮 loss 0.837775；耗时 19 s
summary.en: deployable adapter 4.4 MB; plus merged model 1976 MB (adapter alone is enough); trainable params 1081344; final loss 0.837775; took 19 s
